newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ad market seen rising 5.0 pct in '97 -Havas.
newsitem.headline: French ad market seen rising 5.0 pct in '97 -Havas.

text.p: The French advertising market is likely to show growth of five percent in 1997, Alain de Pouzilhac, chairman of Havas Advertising, said on Thursday.
"We are expecting a rise of five percent in the market this year, which is double the rise in 1996," he told the compnay's annual meeting. DT/SLA
